idea-plugin.name: Progress Tractor
idea-plugin.description:
A fun custom progress bar for JetBrains IDEs: a little tractor plows a field while your build, indexing, Gradle sync or tests are running.

Features

  • Determinate progress: the plowed soil behind the tractor shows how much is done.
  • Indeterminate progress: the tractor drives back and forth across the field.
  • Error and warning states (e.g. failing tests) tint the soil, so status stays visible.
  • Adapts to light and dark themes and HiDPI screens, drawn with Java2D.
  • Zero configuration, no restart required: install it and every progress bar becomes a tractor.

Works in all IntelliJ-based IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, RubyMine, DataGrip, RustRover and Android Studio.
